post.description: Owner/editor only. Upload exactly one multipart file field named file. Content is decoded and must be valid JPEG or PNG, at most 5 MiB and 20 megapixels. Filename and declared MIME type are not trusted. The server chooses a fresh UUID key and detected extension. Up to two uploads run concurrently per backend process; excess requests return 503 with Retry-After. Uploads pass through the backend, so bucket CORS is not required.

file.description: One JPEG or PNG image; maximum 5 MiB and 20 megapixels.

201.description: Image stored. Save the returned path in image_url.

502.description: Cloud Storage or IAM signing failed.

503.description: Image storage is not configured, or both upload slots are occupied.

Retry-After.description: Present for upload-capacity errors; retry after this many seconds.

delete.description: Owner/editor only. Deletes the object, returning 204 if it is already missing. Does not change SQL image_url references. Update/clear saved references before deleting an old image. Cloud Storage soft-delete retention still applies.

post.description: Any member of the selected home may read. All keys are validated before any signing call; cross-home, URL, and traversal inputs are rejected. The batch is all-or-nothing: a missing object returns 404, provider failures return 502. Duplicate paths return one result each. URLs last one hour and are bearer credentials. Cache only until expires_at, scoped to user/home, and clear them on logout or home changes. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.
